「ソフトウェア検証エンジニア」の誕生、という記事
https://t.co/bLTVA5IvfN

・AIエージェントがコードもテストもすべて自動で作成してプルリクエストを送信する時代になりつつある
・テストが通過しても、人間が差分コードを読むだけでは本当に正しい環境で検証されたのか判断できない
・たとえば複数コンポーネントで構成される製品のインストール処理の変更では、新規構築か既存からのアップグレードかといった文脈までコード差分からは読み取れない

・UI変更なら操作手順を録画してナレーションを付けた動画、API変更なら実行ログやレスポンス結果など、代理で検証した証拠の提出が求められる
・従来人間が手動で行っていた検証作業をエージェントに実行させ、その結果を表示させることが重要になる
・開発の増大に従来の人間によるコードレビューで対応するのは限界があり、コードの差分ではなく変更が全体に与える影響や文脈を理解して承認するプロセスへ移行する必要がある

・性能の良いQAエージェントが存在しても、検証に必要な環境や組み合わせの定義がなければ十分な検証はできない
・環境の準備やチェック項目のルール化、提出すべきエビデンスの形式を整えるインフラ構築が必要になる
・変更内容や求める信頼性に応じて、互換性テストや障害からの回復検証など、必要な証拠の形は変化する

・マーティン・ファウラーが指摘するように、テストカバー率100%であってもテストの質が低いケースは存在し、エージェントが要件を誤解したままコードとテストの両方を作成するリスクがある
・要件の変更を勝手に行わせず意図した動作を守らせるには、プロンプトでの指示だけでなく実行可能な検証ルールとしてシステムに組込む必要がある
・セキュリティ脆弱性の報告においても、曖昧な推測や裏付けのない却下ではなく、再現手順や実際の経路を示した明確な証拠が必要になる

・人間が指摘して修正させる繰り返しではなく、エージェント自身が未実行の検証や不足しているエビデンスを検知して補完する仕組みが求められる
・ダン・ルーが描いたハードウェアテストの事例のように、何千台ものマシンで膨大なテストを自動生成して実行するような大規模な検証インフラが必要になる
・曖昧な要件や環境の不備で検証を完了できない場合は、勝手に成功とみなさず未解決の問題として明確に報告させなければならない

・大量のログや録画を出力するだけではレビューの負担が移動するだけなので、承認判断に必要な形に整理して提示する必要がある
・人間は「何を受け入れるのか」「何に影響するのか」「なぜ動作すると信じられるのか」「何が未解決なのか」という4つの問いに回答できる状態を目指す
・チャリティ・メイジャーズが提唱するように、リリース後の段階的な運用監視も不可欠であり、事前検証だけで事故が起きないと過信してはならない

・AIが作成した変更を信頼して受け入れるための検証インフラやルール、エビデンス形式を構築するのがソフトウェア検証エンジニアの仕事である
・ルールや検証基盤の構築自体にもAIを活用できるが、システムが何を保証すべきかを決定して運用する責任は人間に残る
・コード実装をAIが担う時代において、周囲の検証パイプラインの品質と信頼性を飛躍的に高める仕組み作りが不可欠になる

Token launches on @solana are quoted in solana:So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112 or USDC

We integrated @MeteoraAG so the quote can be the stock tokens

The openstock launch studio uses Meteora's Dynamic Bonding Curve SDK

Each stock has its own PoolConfig on mainnet. The program stores the fee, the curve shape, and the graduation threshold, and the studio reads those values from the account before a pool is created

The quote mint is the tokenized stock, so a launch against Nvidia is denominated in that stock rather than in SOL

When the curve fills, the pool migrates to Meteora DAMM v2 and the migrated liquidity is locked

Nvidia and Apple each have three of these configs live: 1.5%, 2%, and 1%.

That integration is OpenStock, a desk for 32 tokenized stocks and the launchpad in front of these configs

TOP 5 — 10/13版

REAの急伸。
今回：約157k★

GitHub Trendingでも+45,327★を記録しました。

ただし、今回さらに注目したいのは新顔です。

調査対象10件から、勢い・実用性・開発更新・新顔度を見て5件を選定。初掲載は2件です。

特に「複数Agentを軽量に動かす」「長時間の作業履歴を圧縮する」ツールが気になります。

🥇 REA — Agentでソフトウェアを解析

約157k★／Trending +45,327★
直近72時間：100コミット以上（取得上限）

アプリ・バイナリの内部を調べるCLI／MCP。Electron、.NET、ネイティブバイナリなどに対応。

Agentが調査を指示
↓
REAで解析
↓
構造や根拠を取得
↓
人間が確認

人間が解析ツールを行き来していた作業を、Agentから進められる点が面白い。

MIT／Local対応。解析対象によってGhidra・Hopperなどの追加ツールが必要になる場合があります。

調査権限のあるソフトウェアに限定して使いたい。

評価：Star増加と開発の動きは引き続き突出。ただし用途は専門的で、Star数は品質や導入実績の保証ではありません。

https://t.co/uQzuD02FA3

約22.0k★／Trending +4,095★

通常の「文章で指示→生成→やり直し」に対して、2D・3D空間でキャラクター・背景・カメラを配置してから画像や動画を作ります。

構図を設計
↓
キャラクター・カメラを配置
↓
AIで画像・動画を生成
↓
結果を見て調整

同じ人物を別アングルで撮る、背景と前景を分けるなど、構図を直接調整できるのが強み。

Star増加は大きい一方、72時間のコミット検索は5件でした。

評価：文章だけで生成を繰り返すのではなく、構図を直接調整できる点が実用的です。

https://t.co/F0EDjrxqFC

約52.6k★／Trending +2,081★

Claude Code、Codexなどから構成図・フローチャート・シーケンス図を生成するAgent Skill。

単なる画像生成ではなく、HTML・SVGで図解を制作するのが特徴です。

文章や構成情報を入力

Agentが内容を整理

HTML・SVGを生成

ブラウザで確認・修正

🗞️13 October 2026 | Daily Edition
17 developments stood out across crypto today, spanning market structure, ETF flows, stablecoin liquidity, DeFi, institutional adoption, regulation, infrastructure, tokenization and sovereign Bitcoin exposure.

1⃣ Bitcoin recovered toward $83.5K after another large liquidation event

Bitcoin fell below $82K during the latest selloff before recovering toward the mid-$83K region.

Approximately $771M of leveraged positions were liquidated over 24 hours, including roughly $686M of long positions.

🖊️ Market significance: Repeated liquidation events show that leverage remains elevated enough to amplify relatively modest spot-market weakness into sharper price declines.

🗨️ My viewpoint: Bitcoin continues to absorb the damage better than higher-beta cryptoassets, but repeated long-liquidation events show that the internal market structure remains fragile.

2⃣ Macro pressure eased slightly ahead of U.S. CPI

The dollar pulled back from its recent 18-month high, oil declined and the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield eased toward roughly 5.19%.

Markets are now focused on the October 14 U.S. CPI release.

🖊️ Market significance: Lower yields, a weaker dollar and softer oil reduce some of the immediate pressure on risk assets, but inflation data could quickly reverse that improvement.

🗨️ My viewpoint: The macro environment has become marginally less hostile, but CPI remains the real test. This is relief, not yet a liquidity regime change.

3⃣ Bitcoin ETF flows turned negative again

U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $65.4M of net outflows on October 12, reversing the small positive session recorded on October 9.

The recent sequence now includes two very large withdrawal days, one small positive day and another negative session.

🖊️ Market significance: The return to outflows shows that Friday's small inflow was not enough to establish a genuine reversal in institutional demand.

🗨️ My viewpoint: Bitcoin ETF flows are still weak. I would need several consecutive positive sessions before treating institutional demand as repaired.

4⃣ Ethereum ETF outflows worsened again

U.S. Ethereum ETFs recorded another $85.4M of net outflows on October 12, extending an already prolonged withdrawal sequence.

🖊️ Market significance: Ethereum's regulated-product weakness is persistent rather than episodic.

🗨️ My viewpoint: Ethereum remains the weakest major institutional-flow structure. ETH does not simply need price stabilization; it needs capital to stop leaving.

5⃣ Solana ETF withdrawals continued

U.S. Solana products recorded another approximately $0.7M of net outflows, extending the recent negative sequence.

🖊️ Market significance: The dollar amount is small, but persistent withdrawals continue to contrast with Solana's improving network and institutional infrastructure.

🗨️ My viewpoint: Solana's fundamentals and regulated capital flows are moving in different directions. Eventually, the investment case needs demand to confirm the infrastructure story.

6⃣ Zcash investment products remained negative

Zcash products recorded another approximately $1.7M of net outflows.

The product has experienced repeated withdrawals despite growing institutional interest around ZEC and privacy-focused investment products.

🖊️ Market significance: The divergence between product development and actual investor allocation remains significant.

🗨️ My viewpoint: Zcash continues to demonstrate that an expanding institutional-product pipeline does not automatically translate into institutional demand.

7⃣ Stablecoin supply remained in contraction

Total stablecoin capitalization remained around $306B, down roughly 0.3% over seven days.

The decline remains modest, but it follows several weeks in which stablecoin liquidity had previously been stable or expanding.

🖊️ Market significance: Stablecoins represent the dollar-equivalent liquidity base of the crypto system. Continued contraction would indicate capital leaving the system itself rather than simply rotating between assets.

🗨️ My viewpoint: ETF withdrawals combined with contracting stablecoin supply are materially less comfortable than ETF withdrawals alone. This remains one of the most important indicators I am watching.

8⃣ DeFi TVL fell back toward $91B while spot activity weakened

Total DeFi TVL declined toward approximately $91B.

Seven-day DEX volume remained significantly lower, while decentralized perpetual-futures activity continued to increase.

🖊️ Market significance: The market continues showing greater appetite for leveraged exposure than for spot deployment and longer-duration capital commitment.

🗨️ My viewpoint: The activity mix remains poor. A healthy recovery should be led by stronger spot participation, not primarily by derivatives.

9⃣ Hong Kong's spot Solana ETF officially listed

The Pando Solana ETF officially began trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on October 13.

The product provides regulated spot SOL exposure through Hong Kong's traditional securities infrastructure.

🖊️ Market significance: Solana's regulated distribution continues expanding outside the United States.

🗨️ My viewpoint: The listing itself is only the first step. The more important evidence will be assets under management, trading volume and whether demand persists beyond launch.

🔟 Blur is shutting down its user-facing NFT business

Blur plans to close its website on November 12, while Blend will stop matching new NFT loans.

The underlying marketplace contracts will remain on Ethereum, but Blur's trading activity has collapsed from its peak.

🖊️ Market significance: Blur demonstrates that large subsidized trading volumes do not necessarily produce sustainable protocol economics.

🗨️ My viewpoint: This is one of the clearest examples of why activity and economic durability must be separated. Volume without sustainable value capture eventually becomes difficult to defend.

1⃣1⃣ Traditional hedge funds are increasingly examining crypto arbitrage

Traditional hedge funds are showing greater interest in crypto venues, including opportunities involving 24/7 trading, derivatives and arbitrage between traditional and digital assets.

Crypto exchanges are simultaneously expanding into equity-linked and other traditional financial products.

🖊️ Market significance: The boundary between traditional and crypto market structure continues to weaken.

🗨️ My viewpoint: The convergence is now happening in both directions. TradFi firms are entering crypto infrastructure while crypto venues increasingly import traditional assets and market structures.

1⃣2⃣ Tether invested in Latin American stablecoin infrastructure

Tether announced an investment in EFY Finance, a company providing stablecoin accounts, payments, custody, OTC services and on/off-ramp infrastructure across Latin America.

EFY says it supports settlement into local accounts across 17 countries.

🖊️ Market significance: Stablecoin adoption increasingly depends on local banking, payment and conversion infrastructure rather than issuance alone.

🗨️ My viewpoint: The stablecoin competition is moving downstream. The most valuable infrastructure may eventually be the rails connecting global stablecoins with domestic financial systems.

1⃣3⃣ Aave is considering a federally regulated U.S. stablecoin

Aave governance is considering onboarding USAT, issued by federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank, onto Aave V3 and the V4 Core Hub on Ethereum.

The proposal remains under governance review and has not yet been implemented.

🖊️ Market significance: Regulated banking infrastructure and permissionless DeFi are beginning to connect more directly.

🗨️ My viewpoint: This is an important direction for DeFi. The distinction between regulated stablecoins and permissionless lending may become increasingly blurred as institutional assets enter open protocols.

1⃣4⃣ Unichain began its OP Enterprise migration

Unichain's testnet migration to OP Enterprise began on October 13, with mainnet migration scheduled for October 29.

The upgrade is intended to support native interoperability between OP Stack networks and reduce reliance on conventional bridge structures.

🖊️ Market significance: Native interoperability could reduce one of the largest sources of friction and risk across Ethereum Layer 2 ecosystems.

🗨️ My viewpoint: The L2 competition is increasingly moving from transaction speed toward liquidity mobility. The chains that make capital movement simplest may have a major advantage.

1⃣5⃣ A UK court ruling increased the possibility of a major sovereign Bitcoin holding

A UK High Court ruled that Chinese law must govern restitution claims involving more than 61,000 BTC seized in the Zhimin Qian fraud case.

The ruling does not determine final ownership, but it could make claimant recovery more difficult.

🖊️ Market significance: If the UK ultimately retains a significant portion of the Bitcoin, it would create one of the world's largest government-controlled BTC positions.

🗨️ My viewpoint: It is too early to say the UK owns 61,000 BTC. But sovereign Bitcoin holdings are increasingly becoming a real market-structure consideration rather than a theoretical possibility.

1⃣6⃣ A dormant Bitcoin whale moved approximately 4,582 BTC

A wallet that had been inactive for more than six years moved roughly 4,582 BTC, worth approximately $378M, into several new addresses.

The coins had not moved to exchanges at the latest observation.

🖊️ Market significance: Large dormant-wallet movements can create potential supply risk if coins eventually move toward exchanges or institutional execution venues.

🗨️ My viewpoint: Wallet movement is not sale evidence. Until exchange deposits or execution activity appears, I would treat this as something to monitor rather than immediate market supply.

1⃣7⃣ The CFTC's crypto framework may face a political timing problem

Analysts estimate that new CFTC rules for leveraged crypto platforms may not be finalized until 2028.

That timeline could expose the framework to court challenges or a future administration before implementation is complete.

🖊️ Market significance: Agency rulemaking can advance crypto regulation even without congressional legislation, but it is generally more vulnerable to political reversal.

🗨️ My viewpoint: This is the weakness of regulation built primarily through agencies. Progress can continue, but without legislation the framework remains less durable and more dependent on who controls the government.

🗨️ My Overall Viewpoint:
Today's market continues to show the same contradiction, but the liquidity side is becoming harder to ignore.

Bitcoin has recovered toward the mid-$83K region and macro pressure has eased slightly.

But beneath that stabilization, the flow picture remains weak.

Bitcoin ETF flows have turned negative again. Ethereum continues losing regulated capital. Solana and Zcash products remain under pressure. Stablecoin supply is still contracting, and DeFi activity continues favouring perpetuals over spot markets.

That combination matters.

The market is stabilizing in price faster than it is stabilizing in capital flows.

At the same time, the infrastructure side remains constructive.

Hong Kong has expanded regulated Solana access. Aave is considering federally regulated stablecoin collateral. Tether is investing deeper into Latin American payments infrastructure. Unichain is improving Layer 2 interoperability, and traditional hedge funds are moving closer to crypto market structure.

So the market still presents two different timelines.

Short term: capital confirmation remains weak.

Long term: financial infrastructure continues to mature.

For me, the next major decision point is CPI.

The sequence remains:
CPI → Treasury yields and the dollar → ETF flows → stablecoin supply → Bitcoin market structure.

If macro conditions improve and capital flows begin following, the market can start building a more credible recovery.

If macro improves but ETF and stablecoin flows continue deteriorating, then the weakness is increasingly crypto-specific rather than purely macro-driven.

$AMD Helion: 128 EPYC CPUs per max-density rack

$AMD $588, -1.1% versus $SOXX -2.2%. The company's new Helion blueprint supports up to 32,768 "Zen 6" CPU cores, equal to 128 of the disclosed 256-core dense-server CPUs at the maximum CPU-only configuration. Availability is planned for November 2026.

The enterprise configuration adds up to 16 MI350P GPUs and 102 Tbps of networking. Its two 8-GPU nodes operate independently without a scale-up GPU fabric, separating Helion's agent execution and localized inference role from the Helios frontier-training rack.

At 128 CPUs per rack, a labeled 1,000-rack scenario at a $1,000 blended EPYC ASP equals $128M of company CPU revenue, or 1.9% of Q2 Data Center sales of $6.7B, before any GPU content. $AMD disclosed no rack pricing, orders or customer volumes, so the launch does not change Q4 estimates yet.

Dell, $HPE, Lenovo, Supermicro, Foxconn and other partners are developing systems. Named deployments and rack volumes determine whether the November blueprint becomes a measurable Data Center revenue lane.

Source: Advanced Micro Devices Helion release, product specifications and Q2 results.

The cause remains unconfirmed.

Hall and Columbia’s Michael Woodford won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics for their work on the microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilization, reframing Keynesian thinking after the 1970s oil crises. Bloomberg: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is on a collision course with Donald Trump, who is increasingly viewing Kyiv’s war with Russia through the lens of energy prices ahead of the US midterms. The US president also suggested the Ukrainian leader should consider stepping aside.

Ilhan Omar’s Washington, D.C., home Monday as part of a criminal investigation reportedly examining possible falsification of immigration documents. The search, coming weeks before November’s elections, raises questions about the Justice Department’s traditional practice of avoiding politically sensitive enforcement actions close to elections.

【今日AI前沿情报·2026年10月12日】

Meta 正式推出首款前沿模型 Muse Wonder 并主打长程智能体，Anthropic 则公开了将模型蒸馏抽取率压低至百分之一的强力防御手段；与此同时，Linus Torvalds 借助 Claude Code 编写内核优化补丁，并顺手挖掘出十多年前的代码缺陷。

【Meta 发布首款前沿模型 Muse Wonder，主打智能体长程任务】
Meta 于 10 月 12 日正式发布 Muse Wonder 及更高规格的 Muse Wonder Full，TechCrunch 称其为 Meta 首款前沿模型。新模型面向个人与专业智能体场景，核心引入 Active Memory（跨对话记忆）与 Active Focus（长任务策略切换）机制。Wonder 已通过 Meta Model API（输入每百万 token 4 美元、输出 20 美元）和 Muse Code 上线；Full 版则不开放 API，仅面向 Muse Code 的 Power Usage 以及额度提升 80 倍的 Maximum Usage 订阅用户，后续将优先接入 Muse 智能体。也有网友反映标准版表现偏弱，部分演示效果评价不一。

【Anthropic 上线强力防蒸馏机制，抽走推理数据降至约百分之一】
据 Anthropic 10 月 12 日发布的研究博客，平台近期全面升级了针对 Claude 的蒸馏防御体系，早期数据显示攻击方能抽取的推理 token 数量已降至原先的 1/10 至 1/100。该系统基于误报率低于 0.1% 的两阶段分类器，防御强度号称与防范生物武器扩散的技术相当，目前已封禁数万个关联账号，并自 9 月 24 日起恢复对被拦截请求的计费。新策略同时波及正常开发流程：Claude Fable 5.1 与 Opus 5.5 引入 preserved thinking 后，新 API 账号无法编辑既有上下文。路透社报道称，Anthropic 在文中指称智谱曾在研发 GLM-5.3 过程中尝试对 Claude 进行蒸馏。

【Linus 借助 Claude Code 编写内核补丁，挖掘出十年前代码缺陷】
据 Phoronix 报道，Linus Torvalds 在其个人仓库开辟了基于 Linux 7.3-rc6 的实验分支，提交了 8 个旨在缓解多线程并发小读取同一文件时 folio 引用计数争用的补丁。他在提交说明中明确指出，相关代码、测试工具、问题梳理和说明初稿均在 Claude Code 辅助下完成，本人主要负责指导与基准测试；其实机测试显示 8 线程小读吞吐量从约每秒 1000 万次提升至 3000 万至 3300 万次。此外，Linus 还借助大模型解析了晦涩的 assoc_array 代码，不仅验证了社区提交的缺陷，还顺带找出 3 个可追溯至 2013 年初始提交的陈年 bug，相关修复预计进入 7.4 合并窗口。

【智谱发布法律智能体模型 GLM-Legal，评测表现逼近 Gemini 4 Argon】
10 月 12 日，智谱推出基于 GLM-5.3-Flash 的垂类模型 GLM-Legal，面向合同审查、证据分析与合规场景，目前 API 实行申请制。第三方评测机构 Vals 榜单显示，其在 Harvey 法律智能体基准上的全通过率为 19.17%，较基座模型的 6.67% 提升显著，逼近 Gemini 4 Argon 的 19.58%；而其单次评测成本仅约 0.15 美元，远低于后者的 10.55 美元，代价是平均运行耗时约 1 小时 12 分钟。榜首目前仍由 Meta Muse Spark 1.2（25.42%）保持。关于该模型权重是否对外开放，目前各方报道尚不一致。

【Grok 与 Cursor 订阅打通为 The X，原有套餐与额度可选择保留】
据 xAI 官方文档及 Cursor 帮助中心公告，Grok、SuperGrok、Cursor 与 X Premium 已正式整合为统一的 “The X Subscription”。现有用户无需强制迁移，可继续保留原有计划、价格与功能；若选择切换至新方案，原订阅立即终止并按新规则生效。切换后，第三方模型额度将改为单独充值计费，而未切换的原 Cursor 用户则在当前计划内继续保留所包含的第三方模型额度。

【Cloudflare Workers 部署宽限期延至 20 分钟，优化 AI 流式传输】
据 Cloudflare 10 月 12 日官方变更日志，平台调整了 Workers 在运行时更新时的连接处理机制：进行中的请求与连接宽限期从过去的最多 30 秒延长至 20 分钟，主要改善长耗时的 AI 流式 HTTP 响应及 WebSocket 连接在部署切换时的稳定性。官方文档特别说明，该 20 分钟宽限期按旧进程整体生命周期计算而非按单个请求计时，到期后残余连接将被强制终止，且 HTTP 请求本身并无硬性墙钟时间上限；官方仍建议开发者在长连接场景中设计好重连与重试逻辑。

投資家は火曜日に既存の住宅販売数や連邦準備制度理事会(FRB)のトム・バーキン氏、スーザン・コリンズ氏のコメントも分析します。

ジョージ氏の計算と、reiさんの反論について

reiさん、はじめまして。ブラジルのサンパウロでAI戦略のコンサルティングと執筆をしているKimと申します。2025年1月の記事「何故ネット民は義務教育で習う群選択説の誤りを忘れるのか？」を興味深く拝読しました。結論には賛成しつつ、論証の進め方についていくつか異なる考えを持ちましたので、敬意を込めて反論を書かせていただきます。もとはポルトガル語で書いた文章を日本語に直したものですので、不自然な表現があればご容赦いただければ幸いです。

reiさんのまとめによれば、ジョージ氏の主張は次のようなものです。無人島に男女10人を送り込んだ場合、男性は1人残れば子孫を残せるので9人は不要になる。一方、女性は1人減るごとに残せる子孫が減る。したがって男女の命の価値は生まれつき違い、男性こそ命を懸けるべきだ、というものです。

男性の命は使い捨てではない、というreiさんの結論に私は同意します。ただ、そこに至るには別の道筋があり、そちらのほうがジョージ氏への反論としては短く、しかも強いのではないかと考えています。

ジョージ氏の計算のうち、正しい部分

反論の出発点として、ジョージ氏の算数の正しい部分を認めておきたいと思います。出生数を制約しているのは妊娠です。女性9人と男性1人の集団は、女性1人と男性9人の集団よりも、多くの子どもをより速く産むことができます。Kolk氏とJebari氏は2022年、学術誌『Population Research and Policy Review』に発表した論文で、この効果を米国の出生力データを用いて試算しています。通常の出生性比では、モデル上の人口は50年でおよそ30%縮小します。一方、出生の80%が女児であれば人口は78%増加します。著者自身はこれを予測ではなく均衡状態の例示として扱っていますが、効果の向きははっきりしています。

問題はその次の一歩、つまり出生数の制約を「命の価値」に読み替えてしまうところにあると考えます。それを示すには、有性生殖のもっとも基本的な数え方で足ります。どの子どもにも、父親と母親が1人ずついます。女性9人と男性1人の島で、最初の世代に40人の子どもが生まれたとしましょう。その男性は40人全員の父親になり、女性たちは平均して4人あまりの子の母親になります。ジョージ氏自身の計算に従えば、「不要」とされたはずの男性が、集団の中でもっとも大きな繁殖上の比重を持つ個体になるのです。数の少ない性ほど、1人あたりの比重は大きくなります。性比が1対1に近づきやすいのはこのためで、進化生物学者ロナルド・フィッシャーが定式化したフィッシャーの原理（性比の原理）は、「群れの利益」という考え方を一切必要としません。

reiさんの記事の優れた点

reiさんの記事には、どのような検証にも耐えると思われる指摘が二つあります。

一つ目は、女性を優先する扱いは普遍的なものではない、という点です。reiさんはタイタニック号の例を挙げ、女性の生存率がおよそ74%、男性がおよそ20%だったことを示したうえで、この傾向は環境によって変わると述べておられます。この点を裏付ける証拠は、記事で示されていた以上に強いものです。スウェーデン・ウプサラ大学の経済学者Elinder氏とErixon氏は、1852年から2011年までに起きた18件の海難事故を分析しました。全体では、女性の生存率は17.8%、男性は34.5%でした。女性が男性を上回ったのは、船長が「女性と子どもを先に」と命じ、暴力による威嚇で徹底させた場合に限られます。タイタニック号は例外であり、ジョージ氏はその例外から一般則を導いていたことになります。

二つ目は、記事の中盤で示された原理です。繁殖のコストをより多く負担する性が求愛される側、つまり配偶者を選ぶ側になるという考え方は、ジョージ氏の主張よりも多くのことを説明できます。この原理を持ち出されたのは的確だったと思います。

論点のずれについて

一方で、気になった点もあります。まず、ジョージ氏の議論は群選択説を必要としていません。彼の計算は、個体がそれぞれ何人の子を残せるかという、個体レベルの話です。そのため記事の多くの部分が、ジョージ氏が実際には用いていない理論への反論に充てられているように見えます。

さらに、記事の「社会科のおさらい」で示された反論は、その直後に誤りとされる考え方と同じ構造を持っているように思います。島には水を運び、道路を整え、連絡役や調停役を務める男性がもっと必要になる、という議論です。これは個体が群れの必要を満たすために存在するという発想であり、数段落後に「誤り」とされている群選択的な論理と重なります。

また、「義務教育で習う」という前提については、記事のコメント欄でも、学校では習わなかったという声がいくつか寄せられていました。

近親交配（記事でいう近親婚）についてのご指摘も、両方向に当てはまります。男性が1人しかいなければ、次の世代は近親交配を避けられません。しかし、これは逆の場合も同じです。一方の性が9人、もう一方が1人という、少数の個体から始まった集団の場合、遺伝学でいう有効集団サイズは、どちらの性が9人の側であっても3.6になります。5人ずつであれば10です。近親交配の問題が示しているのは、両方の性が必要だということです。男性が特に必要だということではありません。

引用されている資料について

ここは、ぜひお伝えしたい点です。reiさんは女児の間引きの歴史を引き、「女性の価値は社会の豊かさとほぼ連動する」という中心的な主張の根拠とされています。その歴史は現実のものであり、痛ましいものです。ただ、根拠として挙げられた資料の内容は、記事での紹介とは異なっていました。

記事では「WHOのパンフレット」として、女児の間引きがパキスタンや西アフリカで広く行われていること、高等教育の不備と貧困率の高い地域ほど顕著であることが紹介されています。リンク先の文書を拝見すると、これは2011年にOHCHR、UNFPA、UNICEF、UNウィメン、WHOの五機関が共同で出した声明でした。扱われているのは、出生後の間引きに加え、現在の主な手段である性別を選択しての中絶を含む「性別選択」全般です。懸念の対象は主に南アジア、東アジア、中央アジアの国々とされています。インドについては、出生性比の上昇が都市部、比較的裕福な世帯、教育水準の高い女性の間でより速かったと記されています。原因としては、婚姻や家族形成、相続制度に組み込まれた女性への差別が挙げられています。つまり、ご紹介の資料は、記事で主張されている因果関係とは逆の傾向を示しているのです。

同じ声明は韓国の事例も取り上げています。韓国の出生性比は1980年代から90年代にかけて116近くまで上昇し、2007年には107に戻りました。声明はその要因として、経済成長、都市化、女性の就業拡大、老後の貯蓄、相続に関わる法改正、そして公的なキャンペーンの組み合わせを挙げています。豊かさは、インドでは問題の一部として、韓国では解決の一部として、両方に登場します。そしてどちらの場合も、社会規範や法律と並んで現れます。豊かさだけで説明できるものではないようです。

「価値」という言葉の幅

記事の後半では、「価値」という言葉が少なくとも四つの意味で使われているように思います。生存の優先順位、社会的地位、性的な市場価値、そして夜の仕事に携わる女性の収入です。記事はバーやキャバクラの倒産を、社会が苦しくなると女性の性的価値が下がることの表れとしています。しかし、reiさん自身が引用された記事の見出しは、倒産の原因を「コロナ禍と物価高」としています。この説明であれば、記事の仮説を持ち出さなくても同じデータを説明できてしまいます。

記事の終盤では、前半でジョージ氏に求めていた厳密さが手薄になっているように感じました。主たる生計維持者の95%が男性だという数字には、出典が示されていません。女性は男性に比べて時空間の認知範囲が狭い、という主張の根拠は、reiさんご自身の別の記事だけです。少子化の原因を女性側の要求に求める部分にも、因果関係を確かめる検証が見当たりません。どの主張についても、どのような事実が見つかれば覆るのかという条件が示されていないのです。

同じ物差し

結局のところ、ジョージ氏とreiさんは同じ物差しを使っておられるのではないでしょうか。ジョージ氏は人を、子を産む能力で量ります。reiさんは女性を、その女性を支える社会の豊かさで量ります。違うのは、どちらの側に得があるかという点だけです。人口学には「繁殖価」という専門用語があります。ある個体が将来の世代に残すと期待される寄与のことで、年齢や生存率、置かれた状況によって変わります。人口の予測には役立つ量ですが、救命ボートの席に誰がふさわしいかについては何も語りません。

ジョージ氏への反論は、三つの文で済んだのではないかと思います。妊娠が出生数を制約する。どの子にも父と母がいるので、数の少ない性ほど1人あたりの比重は大きくなる。そして、どちらの計算も、繁殖能力を人の尊厳に換算する根拠にはならない。

長文にお付き合いいただき、ありがとうございました。私の読み違いがあれば、ご指摘いただけますと幸いです。

Kim

Trolls will never understand a self-sacrificing leader... Donald Trump doesn’t have an accomplishment problem. Republicans have an information problem. It’s on each of us to change that.
With the midterms coming, an astonishing number of Republican voters cannot name three things President Trump has accomplished. Which is remarkable when you consider that Donald Trump has accomplished more in a year and a half than any other president ever did in four.
Indeed, he has accomplished so much, so fast, across so many fronts that most people cannot keep up. The Enemedia buries the victories, while Republicans do an abysmal job of explaining them.
So here is the cheat sheet. It barely scratches the surface. And yet each and every item here is a game-changer, and your befuddled black-pilling friends need to know it.
This is not a list of promises. It’s a list of laws enacted, cases won, policies implemented, agreements secured, and measurable results.
You don’t have to memorize all 25. Learn five. And when somebody says Trump “hasn’t done much,” show them the receipts.
Trump Restored American Safety and Sovereignty
1. He made the border a real border again.
In a matter of months, Trump reduced illegal border crossings to their lowest level in half a century. Catch-and-release is finished. The wall is going up and even being expanded, “Remain in Mexico” is back, and the Administration reduced releases into the country by an incredible 99.9 percent.
2. He reversed mass migration.
America recorded negative net migration in 2025 for the first time in at least half a century. So far, nearly 3 million illegal aliens have left the country, whether voluntarily or involuntarily: more than 675,000 forcibly deported and the rest “self-deported.”
Many of those self-deportations were facilitated by the President’s innovative program to offer plane tickets and cash bonuses for illegals to leave, not only incentivizing good behavior but significantly reducing the cost of deportations. Citizenship and the law actually mean something again.
3. He signed the Laken Riley Act — and required detention of criminal illegal aliens.
Named for an innocent girl murdered by an illegal alien, the Laken Riley Act requires federal authorities to detain illegals arrested for theft, burglary, shoplifting, assaulting police, or any crime causing death or serious injury. It also lets states sue officials who refuse to enforce it.
Laken Riley should still be alive. This law will prevent tragedies like hers.
4. History’s biggest drop in violent crime, and the lowest violent crime rate in 126 years.
According to FBI data, violent crime in America dropped an incredible 9.7 percent in 2025 — the largest one-year decline in history. Murder fell 18.1 percent, robbery fell 18.5 percent. And America’s violent crime rate is its lowest since 1900.
This is what happens when you put the National Guard on the streets in crime-ridden blue cities: fewer victims, safer streets, and better futures for America’s poorest.
Trump Launched an American Industrial Supercycle
5. He made the 2017 tax cuts permanent…and better.
The One Big Beautiful Bill locked in the largest tax cut in modern history, including the doubled standard deduction, the expanded Child Tax Credit, and 100 percent expensing for factories and equipment. It also delivered No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, an abolition of most taxes on Social Security benefits, and major relief for seniors.
Every Democrat voted no. With the 2017 act set to expire in December 2025, that would have resulted in the largest tax hike in American history.
6. He repealed 129 regulations for every new one.
In fiscal 2025, federal agencies finalized 646 deregulatory actions and just five regulatory actions: 129-to-1, and in nearly every case, the “one” was to repeal the others! OIRA says the savings exceeded those of Trump’s entire first term. That is more freedom, lower costs, and less bureaucratic sabotage.
Of these, the crown jewel was the repeal of Obama’s 2009 “Endangerment Finding”, the legal foundation for the Green New Scam’s vehicle mandates. EPA calls it the largest deregulatory action in American history and estimates that by itself, it will save Americans more than $1.3 trillion. Trump also killed the federal EV mandate, restored Americans’ freedom to buy the cars and trucks they actually want, and even eliminated the incentives behind the almost universally hated start-stop button.
7. He secured $18 trillion in announced investment commitments.
That’s nearly two-thirds the size of the entire American economy, building American factories, chip plants, data centers, energy projects, steel mills, shipyards, and supply chains employing American workers. Apple, Meta, NVIDIA, Micron, Hyundai, U.S. Steel, Ford, Taiwan Semiconductor, and many corporations and sovereign wealth funds are betting big on Trump’s America.
No President has ever done anything remotely like it. And it’s just getting started.
8. He made “reshoring” and “reindustrialization” real, not a slogan.
Ford is moving Lincoln production out of China. Toyota is shifting Tacoma production from Mexico to Texas. GM, Honda, Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis, and others are expanding U.S. production. The capital equipment pouring into the country is the machinery that’s building the growing boom.
9. He replaced lopsided trade deals with balanced, reciprocal trade.
Trump used tariffs as leverage to reverse 80 years of lopsided trade deals that favored everyone but America, and to win new or improved agreements with trading partners accounting for more than half of global GDP. Those agreements open foreign markets, attack non-tariff barriers, defend strategic industries, and make it more profitable to build in America than to export American jobs.
10. He shifted global energy dominance from the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of America.
Once the world’s largest energy importer — “exporting” $700 billion a year to our enemies — America now outproduces Saudi Arabia and Russia combined. The U.S. is also setting new records in oil, natural gas, and LNG exports, becoming the first country ever to export more than 100 million metric tons of LNG in a year.
Trump also opened land, accelerated permits, expanded pipelines and export terminals, and made American energy a tool for prosperity and peace.
11. After four decades of nuclear paralysis, Trump brought five new reactors online in a single year.
For more than 40 years, not one new privately developed non-light-water reactor reached criticality in America. Trump ordered at least three by July 4, 2026. DOE delivered four by the deadline, then a fifth just one month later.
Decades of zero. One Trump summer: five. That is a genuine nuclear renaissance.
Trump Made Elections Matter Again
12. He broke the Deep State’s power to defy the elected branches.
In Trump v. Slaughter, the Supreme Court ruled for the first time in 90 years that Article 2, Section 1 is still part of the Constitution: the President may fire subordinate officials in the executive branch, overturning the 1935 precedent that insulated “independent” agencies from voters’ control.
Ever wonder why elections often seem to change nothing? How about one President and 5,000 political appointees vs. 2.8 million unfireable, unaccountable bureaucrats? THAT is the “Deep State”.
Trump then made that victory real. For the first time in a century, all policy-making bureaucrats can now be fired for misconduct, incompetence, or defying lawful directives. The permanent bureaucracy no longer gets to veto the voters.
13. He ended nationwide injunction abuse.
In Trump v. CASA, the Supreme Court sharply limited nationwide injunctions. A single, local, district judge should not be able to block a national policy for everyone, everywhere; and yet that’s exactly what they’ve done, nonstop, ever since Trump (and only Trump) took office in 2017.
In restricting that unconstitutional power, the Court kneecapped the Black Robe Bureaucracy’s favorite tool of unlawful judicial supremacy.
14. He shut down USAID as a left-wing slush fund and shadow government.
USAID had become a taxpayer-funded machine for exporting abortion, gender ideology, censorship, and left-wing politics. It had a bigger budget than the CIA and the State Department combined, absolutely no accountability whatsoever, and a penchant for overthrowing governments.
Trump terminated it — completely — and moved real humanitarian aid under the State Department. Immediately, seven socialist Latin American governments lost re-election. Coincidence?
15. He shrank Federal employment to its lowest level in 60 years.
From a high under Biden, the federal workforce is now its smallest since 1966. Workforce reductions, agency closures, and spending cancellations mean fewer bureaucrats paid to resist the voters.
What’s more, when Biden left office, 94 percent of federal employees “worked” from home. The Trump administration cracked down: as Elon Musk put it, “you can work from the office or you can pretend to work somewhere else.”
16. He expelled DEI from the federal government.
Trump eliminated federal DEI offices and barred race- and sex-based preferences across the executive branch. Government hiring and contracting are returning to merit and equality under the law, ending the grotesque Democrat idea that “fighting discrimination” requires the federal government to discriminate.
He Defended Faith and Family
17. He delivered sweeping pro-life reform.
In his first term, Trump delivered the judges that overturned the abominable Roe v. Wade. Hardly anyone believed it could be done, or that Trump would do it. But he did, and a half-century nightmare finally ended.
Since returning to office, Trump has enforced the Hyde Amendment prohibiting the use of federal funds to pay for abortions, reinstated and expanded the Mexico City Policy prohibiting federal funding of foreign abortions, ended federal fetal-tissue research, strengthened conscience protections, protected Medicaid from funding large abortion providers, and pardoned 23 pro-life activists prosecuted by Biden’s weaponized Justice Department.
He’s also done everything within the Executive Branch’s power to defund Planned Parenthood. It would be nice if Congress did likewise.
No President has ever done more to protect life. No one.
18. He got men out of women’s sports, and restored biological reality to federal policy.
The United States government once again officially recognizes two sexes: male and female. Trump ended federal support for the chemical and surgical gender mutilation of children, stopped taxpayer funding of such irreversible abominations, and forced more than three dozen health systems to end or suspend their programs as well.
Trump also enforced Title IX as written: women and girls deserve their own teams, trophies, scholarships, and locker rooms. The NCAA and other athletic organizations changed their rules in response. After years of Democrats doing everything they could to destroy women’s sports and ruin girls’ lives, Trump’s administration protects women and girls again.
19. He enacted America’s first nationwide school-choice program — and launched Trump Accounts.
As part of the President’s One Big Beautiful Bill, Trump enacted America’s first-ever nationwide school choice program. The new Education Freedom Tax Credit helps fund scholarships for tuition, books, and other educational costs.
That’s on top of the new Trump Accounts, which give every child a tax-advantaged stake in America’s future, including a $1,000 federal seed for eligible newborns. Parents gain power. Bureaucracies lose it. And children learn first-hand about free markets and future orientation.
20. He targeted anti-Christian bias and discrimination.
Trump created the White House Faith Office, Religious Liberty Commission, and Task Force to Eradicate Anti-Christian Bias. He restored conscience protections and made clear that Christians do not surrender their First Amendment rights merely by entering public life.
He Restored Peace Through Strength and Put America First
21. He forced NATO to stop freeloading and increase defense spending by 250 percent.
For decades, wealthy European governments underfunded their militaries, effectively sending America the bill and using American taxpayers to subsidize their bloated welfare states. Trump forced NATO to replace its old two-percent-of-GDP spending target with an enormous five percent by 2035.
Allied spending is rising, American defense orders are soaring, and Europe is becoming a partner instead of a dependent.
22. He drove China out of the Caribbean.
China spent years building strategic beachheads at both ends of the Panama Canal, in Cuba, and in Maduro’s Venezuela. Trump forced Panama out of Belt and Road, expanded American security access around the Canal, and captured Maduro, who now sits in a New York jail cell awaiting trial.
Beijing’s planned encirclement of the United States collapsed. The Monroe Doctrine is back. Call it the Donroe Doctrine.
23. He brokered eight peace deals in just eight months.
In eight months, Trump brokered peace in eight conflicts spanning four continents, including wars that had gone on for as much as 40 years. It’s a record unmatched by any other President.
24. He launched and funded Golden Dome, the first-ever true missile defense for the U.S. population.
Ronald Reagan dreamed of making nuclear missiles obsolete through his Strategic Defense Initiative. Today, Trump is actually building it: a layered homeland shield with space-based sensors and interceptors, conventional defenses, and new technologies including microwave systems to destroy drone swarms and directed-energy weapons (yes, lasers) that can replace an $11 million missile with $2 of electricity.
Congress has funded the initial $25 billion, with far more on the way once it passes the NDAA this fall. Better a shield than a sword.
25. He restored the warrior ethos — and reversed the recruiting crisis.
After years of missed targets under Biden, every active military component met or exceeded its 2025 recruiting goal. Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth refocused the newly renamed Department of War on actually winning wars, while pouring resources into shipbuilding, munitions, drones, missile defense, and America’s atrophied industrial base.
Young Americans once again believe their Commander-in-Chief is worth serving. And they’re showing up en masse.
Now, Act Like It Matters
Those are not tweets or campaign promises. They are changes in law, power, investment, sovereignty, culture, and the structure of the Republic itself. And they’re just the top 25: I could give you hundreds more.
Midterms are turnout elections. We do not need to convince Democrats to love Donald Trump. We need Republicans and friendly independents to understand what is at stake — and to show up.
And let’s be clear. When you say (as some of you will) “the Republicans need to do a good enough job telling this story”, you’re pointing at yourself. You are “the Republicans.” The Democrats don’t rely exclusively on their elected officials to tell their story: everyone from their media lackeys to their lowest-level supporters are constantly spreading their “news”, whatever that “news” happens to be.
Today’s conservatives have more ability to find whatever you want to know than any group of people in human history, yet half of them couldn’t name any of the accomplishments in this essay, and if they were to read it, they would just complain that something else they wanted hasn’t happened fast enough to suit them.
This is called “black-pilling.” It’s a loser mindset, and if you engage in it, you deserve to lose: horribly, painfully, personally. And guess what: you will, unless people who are serious step up to save you. Which is frankly pathetic, but for the rest of our sakes, necessary.
So tell people our story. Donald Trump is delivering great things, whether or not Heaven on Earth has broken out quite yet. Do the work, send the team he needs to Washington to finish the job, and get ready for 2028 afterward.
Take the time to learn at least five of these victories. Share this list with someone who needs it. And vote as though the most consequential Presidency in modern history depends on what you do.
Because it does.

2026年8月14日公表の第5四半期累計決算は、営業収益490.41億円、営業利益36.38億円、親会社株主に帰属する純利益47.05億円。対象は2025年4月〜2026年6月の15か月で、前年の12か月決算とは単純比較できません。

純利益には、こころネットの子会社化に伴う負ののれん発生益28.10億円が影響。一方、営業段階では、きずなHD等の買収に伴うのれん償却9.21億円や、出店・採用関連費用を負担しています。一度の取得益と継続的な費用は性質が違います。

自社で買収を検討する際も、提示された純利益だけで判断せず、通常の営業利益、統合後に増える費用、返済に回せる現金を別々に確認する。買収初年度の見栄えと、翌年以降の収益力を分けて見たいところです。

先週、キオクシアについて0.5%以上の機関空売りがほぼなく、誰かが強烈に売り崩しているというより、買い手が次の材料を待っている相場ではないかと書きました。

そして待っている材料として以下の３つを挙げました。
① メモリ価格上昇が次の決算でどこまで利益率改善につながるか
② 10月末・11月末の浮動株比率見直しによる指数需給
③ 東芝の売却がどこまで進み、オーバーハングが軽くなるか

今日、この見方を少しアップデートする必要があります。キオクシアは15,180円、-13.3％。売買代金は約9,800億円、ほぼ1兆円まで膨らみました。つまり先週までのような買い手が引いて出来高が細っているという相場ではなさそうです。今日は明確に、大きなポジション整理が起きています。ただし、公表ベースでは依然として0.5％以上の大口機関空売りが目立っていません。なので今回の急落も、巨大なショート勢が売り崩しているというより、半導体全体の期待値調整と、高値圏で積み上がったロングの投げ、東芝の継続的な持分縮小による現物供給（先週変更報告書がでています）この組み合わせで考える方が自然だと思っています。東芝の保有比率は10月1日時点で12.84％から11.80％へ低下。以前17％台だったことを考えれば売却はかなり進んでいますが、市場から見ればまだ売りが出てくるのではないかというオーバーハングは残ります。

さらに今日は、これまで意識していた三角持ち合いも完全に崩れ、自社株買いの平均取得価格を現在株価ベースに換算した約16,500円も割りました。なので短期的には強気一本で見る場面ではありません。いまは新しいレンジの下限を探している段階。しかも、自社株買いラインも残念ながら下回ってしまいました。

こうなるとキオクシアの決算発表の10月30日（2027年2Q）まではトレンドが変化しない可能性も高いでしょう。むしろレンジとなれば前回安値の12000円すら意識されかねません。メモリ市況が利益に変わるか。東芝の売りが一巡するか。そしてTOPIXの指数需給が入ってくるか。特にTOPIXでは、キオクシアの浮動株比率が10月末に0.325、11月末に0.50へ段階的に引き上げられる予定ではあります。

結局、次に必要なのは期待ではなく実績としての数字です。NAND価格上昇が本当に利益率改善につながるのか。AI・データセンター需要がどこまでSSD需要に届いているのか。ここが確認でき、東芝の売りが一巡し、指数買いまで重なれば、今の約1兆円の売買代金で整理された株が、そのまま次の上昇の土台になる可能性があります。

今日は確かに売りが強かった。ただ、売買代金約1兆円を伴ったこの下げを、単なる人気離散とも見ていません。短期は底を探しつつも、中期は決算・東芝・TOPIX。先週挙げた主役復帰条件は消えたのではなく、むしろ今から一つずつ答え合わせに入る局面だと思っていますが、しばらくは厳しい展開もありうると覚悟が必要そうです。

Know Before Your Customers Do: Introducing Exla AI

Every team has had this moment. A customer emails support: "This hasn't worked since Tuesday." You open your logs. Thousands of lines. Almost all of them fine. Somewhere in there is the answer, and you have no idea where to start.

Nothing crashed. Nothing paged. One customer was quietly failing for days.

That is the problem Exla AI was built to solve.

What is Exla AI?

Exla AI is AI customer monitoring for your logs. It reads your production logs, sorts every line by customer, and tells you three things in plain English: what broke, who it broke for, and why.

Sentry tells you what broke. Exla tells you which customers it broke for, why, and how to fix it.

How it works: Spot, Understand, Fix

Spot. Every log line is grouped by customer. Customers with problems rise to the top under "Needs attention." Everyone else gets a simple "Healthy." You stop scrolling through noise and start with the people who are actually affected.

Understand. Each problem is explained in one clear sentence, like "HubSpot rejects Northwind's contact updates because the software_used field is read-only." The real log lines sit right underneath, so you can verify it yourself instead of trusting a black box.

Fix. Paste the finding into Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent starts at the root cause instead of guessing, and the fix lands in minutes, not days.

Built for the way you already work

A morning briefing shows which customers need attention and why, on your dashboard or in Slack.

When a customer breaks from their usual pattern, the right person gets tagged in Slack with the reason and the log line.

Through MCP, you can ask your logs questions directly from your editor: "Did checkout get slower for anyone since yesterday's deploy?" One customer, one cause, one fix.

Why Exla?

Same logs, half your Datadog bill. Flat pricing per GB, no seat fees, no query fees, and 365 days of retention instead of 15.

Setup takes one prompt in your coding agent. It detects your stack, wires up logging, and waits for your approval. Nothing is pushed to your repo until you say yes. You can start free with 5 GB and no card.

The bottom line

Your logs already know which customers are failing. Exla AI makes sure you know too, before they have to tell you.

Spot. Understand. Fix.

【話題】タマホームさん、金利上昇と建築費高騰で消費者がビビり散らかし主力の注文住宅が売れず順当に赤字を叩き出すも、裏では分譲用の土地をゴリゴリ買い漁って建売の在庫をひたすら積み上げ、通期での利益倍増に向けた物量作戦の仕込みへ全ツッパしている件ｗｗ

タマホーム（1419）の長い決算短信を要約すると、
・売上高276億円（△5.1％）、営業赤字45億円。「1Qはいつも赤字だお」という安心と信頼のテンプレ展開
・注文住宅の引渡棟数が487棟で前年比12.4％減。住宅ローン金利アップと資材高で買い手がチキってて草
・焦って営業マンを増員しつつ、需要高めの「平屋」を激推ししてワンチャン受注を取りに行こうと必死
・その代わり、不動産事業（戸建分譲）は引渡325棟（+11.3％）と好調。土地をゴリゴリ仕入れて建売をさばく戦法には激しく同意
・リフォーム事業は既存オーナーにエコキュートを売りつけるクロスセルが刺さり、単価アップでメシウマ状態
・メガソーラーの売電も手堅く稼いでて、エネルギー事業の利益+10％。「チリツモしか勝たん」

【小まとめ】
表面上はローン金利に殴られてオワタ感出しつつ、裏では別のタマ（土地と建売）をひたすら仕込んで後半戦のボーナスステージを狙う欲張りフルレバレッジ大工

【つづき】
・未成工事支出金やら仕掛販売用不動産などの「作りかけ在庫」だけで約168億円も爆増、後半に向けて売る気マンマンで胸熱
・その仕込みの資金繰りで長期借入金が一気に132億円も増大、これぞTHE・レバレッジ
・結果として自己資本比率が前期末の34.3％から22.2％へ急降下。一見すると財務悪化に見えるがお約束の様式美なので震えて眠れ
・これだけ豪快に借金して赤字を掘っているのに、通期予想は据え置き
・通期の営業利益75億円（+95.2％）で利益ほぼ倍増を狙う計画。「最後はワイらが勝つから見とけ（ ﾟДﾟ）ゴルァ！」と強気すぎんだろ

【結論】
第1四半期特有の赤字と借金132億円増大による自己資本比率の急降下という初見殺しのコンボを華麗にスルーし、営業利益ほぼ倍増の通期予想は据え置きのまま後半戦の爆益回収フェーズへ向けて全裸待機中です。

records.text:
【イオン（8267）2027年2月期2Q決算まとめ】

結論から言うと、

「売上・営業利益は過去最高。ただし、ツルハ連結による増益が大きく、主力スーパーの収益悪化はかなり気になる」

という決算。

見た目ほど強い決算ではないと思います。

■ 上期実績

営業収益：5兆9,042億円（+13.8%）
営業利益：1,307億円（+10.7%）
経常利益：1,083億円（+1.7%）
純利益：133億円（+229.1%）

営業利益率は、
2.28% → **2.22%**へ低下。

増収増益ですが、売上成長率ほど利益は伸びていません。

しかも今回の増収には、ツルハHDの連結子会社化という大型M&A効果が含まれています。

つまり、イオンの既存店舗だけで13.8%成長したわけではありません。

■ 最大の増益要因はドラッグストア

ヘルス＆ウエルネス事業は、

営業利益：597億円
前年差：+370億円

と大幅増益。

ツルハHDの連結化に加え、ウエルシアとの統合効果が寄与しています。

統合シナジーは上期で約85億円。

年間計画150億円に対して順調です。

ただし既存店を見ると、

売上：+2.5%
客数：▲0.7%

客単価や調剤の成長が売上を支える一方、客数自体は減少。

ドラッグ事業の規模拡大は非常に強いですが、既存店の集客力には注意が必要です。

■ 商業施設も好調

商業施設・エンタメ事業は、

営業利益：542億円
前年差：+132億円

と大幅増益。

イオンモールの専門店売上が伸長し、リニューアルした32モールでは売上+6.8%。

飲食・娯楽・体験型施設などが集客に寄与しています。

こちらは既存施設の収益改善も確認でき、かなり評価できる部分です。

■ 一方で、主力スーパーは厳しい

GMS（総合スーパー）は、

営業利益：▲126億円
前年差：▲124億円

スーパーマーケット事業も、

営業利益：▲2億円
前年差：▲131億円

と大幅悪化。

イオンリテールでは既存店売上が+0.6%と伸び悩み、低価格施策や人件費増加などが収益を圧迫しました。

スーパーでも客数・買上点数の伸び悩み、販促強化、店舗改装費などが重荷に。

つまり、

「ドラッグストアとモールで稼ぎ、主力スーパーの赤字を補っている」

という構造です。

ここは少し気になります。

■ 実は2Q単独では減益

上期累計では過去最高益ですが、6〜8月の3カ月だけを見ると、

営業収益：約2兆9,622億円（+12.9%）
営業利益：約555億円（▲10.2%）
経常利益：約447億円（▲23.5%）
純利益：約▲4.9億円

です。

売上は2桁成長なのに、営業利益は減益。

1Qの営業利益+33.6%から大きく減速しています。

これは今回の決算で特に注意したい数字です。

■ 純利益+229%にも特殊要因

純利益が約3.3倍になったからといって、本業の稼ぐ力が3倍になったわけではありません。

特別損益は、

前年上期：約▲236億円
今期上期：約▲105億円

と約131億円改善。

前年に発生した減損損失や店舗閉鎖関連費用などの減少が、純利益を大きく押し上げています。

今期にも退職給付制度改定益などの一時利益があります。

そのため、純利益+229%という数字をそのまま評価するのは危険。

本業を見るなら営業利益、さらに2Q単独の減益まで確認する必要があります。

■ 通期予想は据え置き

営業収益：12兆円
営業利益：3,400億円
経常利益：2,900億円
純利益：730億円

上期時点の進捗率は、

営業収益：49.2%
営業利益：38.4%
純利益：18.2%

特に純利益の進捗率は低め。

小売業には季節性があるため単純判断はできませんが、下期の利益回復が重要になります。

■ 今後の主なリスク

① GMS・スーパーの収益悪化
低価格競争や人件費増による採算圧迫。

② ツルハ・ウエルシア統合リスク
統合シナジーが計画通り継続するか。

③ 営業利益率の低さ
約6兆円の上期営業収益に対して営業利益率は2.22%。小さなコスト変動でも利益への影響が大きい。

④ 消費者の節約志向
物価上昇による買上点数減少や価格競争の激化。

⑤ 財務・投資負担
大型M&Aや店舗投資に対して、営業CF・FCFと借入負担を継続確認する必要があります。

■ 総評

今回の評価は、

決算内容：B
ドラッグ事業：A
商業施設：A-
GMS・スーパー：D
利益の質：B-
通期達成：要確認

という印象。

イオンはもはや単純なスーパー企業ではなく、ドラッグストア・商業施設・金融などを抱える巨大流通グループです。

成長事業の競争力は非常に強い。

ただし、

「M&Aによる規模拡大」と「既存事業の収益性改善」は別物。

今回の決算では、前者は進んでいるものの、後者にはまだ大きな課題が残っています。

今後の株価を左右するのは、

①GMS・スーパーの赤字縮小
②ツルハ統合シナジーの拡大
③2Q単独で悪化した利益率の回復
④通期営業利益3,400億円の達成

結論としては

「ドラッグとモールは強い。ただ本業小売の採算改善が確認できるまでは、過去最高益という見出しだけで強気にはなれない」

という決算でした

总体市场评分：5.5/10（方向性情绪：+0.5）

主要偏多因素：
- NVIDIA宣布本周将在欧洲投入20亿美元AI投资，直接利好半导体和AI产业链，提振科技板块信心。
- Anthropic据报将于10月14日举行机构投资者日，为潜在IPO做准备，显示AI公司融资与估值仍获市场关注。
- 特朗普与沙特王储通话，显示中东外交渠道保持开放，可能缓解部分地缘紧张。

主要偏空因素：
- 胡塞武装控制的卫生部称红海沿岸油港遭袭致2死，油港安全风险上升，可能推高能源价格并引发避险情绪。
- 伊朗与土耳其外长通话讨论也门及地区局势，地缘政治紧张升级迹象明显。
- 特朗普表示将就伊朗问题做出决定，并提及胡塞行为恶劣，市场担忧中东冲突扩大。
- OpenAI警告可能存在更多未被发现的AI代理失控事件，AI安全担忧或影响科技股估值。

相比上次更新的变化：
- 新增红海油港袭击事件，地缘风险从也门相关讨论升级为直接油港安全威胁，油价敏感度上升。
- 特朗普对伊朗和也门表态增多，外交与军事信号增强，相比此前俄罗斯停火乐观情绪，风险偏好有所回落。
- NVIDIA欧洲投资和Anthropic投资者日提供科技正面催化剂，部分抵消地缘压力。

未来几小时关注点：

Yes, absolutely. And this is one reason I never rely on technical indicators alone.

Relative strength tells me where the market is rewarding companies. Supply chain analysis helps me understand WHY that might change.

Look at AI infrastructure.

Demand can remain strong, but bottlenecks in advanced packaging, HBM, power delivery or cooling can determine which companies actually convert that demand into revenue.

TSMC reported September revenue growth of 54.6% year over year. That supports strong underlying chip demand.

But there is another development worth watching.

Broadcom's CEO recently warned that capital availability could become a bigger constraint on AI expansion than wafer or memory supply.

That changes the equation.

A company can have strong demand and still face delayed orders if customers cannot finance expansion.

So I am watching four things:

Order growth and backlog conversion.
Capacity utilization, lead times and production yields.
Pricing power and margin improvement.
Customer capex commitments and actual spending.

If those improve while individual stocks begin outperforming their sector benchmarks, I would take that as early evidence of rotation.

But SOXX still has -7.58% RS63D. The market is not confirming renewed semiconductor leadership yet.

For me, supply chain evidence can identify the next opportunity before the technicals fully confirm it.

But I still need price to validate the thesis before committing capital.

Strong demand is not automatically strong earnings. And strong earnings are not automatically a good entry.

World Daily Brief — October 12, 2026

1. Russia-Ukraine: Trump's Putin diesel deal and a disputed "energy ceasefire" strain ties with Kyiv and Europe

President Trump has spent the past four days upending the diplomacy around the war. On Friday he announced a deal with Putin to lift US sanctions on Russian fuel, with Russia to supply 300,000 tons of diesel immediately, 500,000 tons in November, and 1 million tons after that — framed as a way to bring down diesel prices alongside oil flowing from Hormuz. Zelensky called the move "weak," warning it would generate "millions, billions" in extra revenue for Putin, and said any sanctions relief outside a lasting de-escalation agreement is a mistake. The announcement came as Ukrainian and European diplomats arrived in Miami for talks. On Saturday Trump said Kyiv should "get a new leader who can make a deal," while demanding Ukraine stop striking Russian oil refineries — which White House officials say are hurting Zelensky's standing with Trump more than they damage Russia.

On Sunday Trump posted that "there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE" between the two countries "effective immediately," claiming both sides had agreed. Zelensky told Axios the announcement "was news for me," though he said Ukraine would halt energy strikes if Russia does the same, and floated holding new elections in exchange for a 60-day ceasefire. The Kremlin's Dmitry Peskov said only that "contacts are ongoing." A White House official later said Trump meant a narrower arrangement covering oil refineries, with a deal on power plants and grids possibly to follow; Ukrainian officials reported a Russian strike on a power plant in Kharkiv after the announcement, and Russian drones hit apartment buildings there Monday. The EU called the Trump-Putin deal "concerning" and insisted its own sanctions on Russia will continue, while the Baltic states remain on alert. Zelensky accused Putin of defying Trump's push, saying a ceasefire "depends on the blocking of Hormuz Strait" in how Moscow weighs its options.

2. Saudi Arabia/Yemen: Second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days; Washington weighs joining Saudi retaliation

A Houthi missile hit a passenger terminal at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Sunday, killing one person and wounding 11, a day after a separate strike on the same terminal killed at least 12 people — including an American — and injured more than 300, many critically. Saudi authorities cancelled flights and suspended airport operations; Riyadh schools have again moved to remote learning, the second time in under a month. Houthi-aligned media report Saudi warplanes bombed Sanaa International Airport and other sites around the Yemeni capital, and the Houthis have warned of further strikes on Saudi targets. Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia's other partners condemned the attacks, and WORLD Radio reports the White House is weighing possible US involvement in Saudi strikes on the Houthis. The escalation sits awkwardly beside Trump's pledge last week not to attack Iran before the November 3 midterms.

3. Iran war: US to keep pressure on as Pentagon quietly raises its casualty count

The Trump administration says it will keep up pressure on Iran, even as it holds off strikes until after the midterms. The Pentagon quietly raised its count of US troops killed and wounded in the Iran war on Friday without a public announcement, per Havana Times, while rights groups and lawmakers voice alarm over a continuing pattern of civilian casualties from US operations and the lack of accountability. Fuel costs remain a global strain: 94 countries had introduced consumer fuel-price relief by late September, up from 56 in April, according to figures cited by the Christian Science Monitor.

4. Ongoing threads worth tracking

Taiwan/China: Taiwan says it is closely monitoring a series of Chinese live-fire drills; Beijing sanctioned ministers from Paraguay and Belize over Taiwan ties.

France: A poll shows Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon heading for a run-off as the country's political divide deepens; a major overnight fire gutted Paris's oldest covered food market.

India: Delhi shut metro stations and restricted traffic ahead of a new protest against the election chief; deadly clashes in Manipur have raised that state's toll to nine.

Migration: The UN reports 109 migrants dead and 116 missing after a boat capsized off Djibouti.

Nepal: Fresh flash floods have hit homes and bridges months after the Himalayan disaster.

South Africa: The government withdrew an asylum directive after anti-migrant violence; protests against migrants continue to swell.

China: The $11 billion Pinglu Canal has opened, linking inland China to Southeast Asia via the Gulf of Tonkin.

The chatbot era is ending. Decision models are AI's new gold rush, and today's brief shows the entire industry repricing around them.

- TypeSafe's Jev, built by a ChatGPT co-creator, closed $870M at a $7.5B valuation one month after launch. Microsoft shipped a clone, Decision-1, on Alibaba's Qwen3.5-9B weights the same week.

- OpenAI told investors ARR is roughly $50B, about $20B below the whisper number. Nvidia, Oracle, and CoreWeave sold off like it was a public earnings miss.

- Nadella says treat every model as an already-compromised insider: zero trust, tamper-proof logs, kill switch. Days later, an Anthropic agent filed a false murder tip with Philadelphia police.

- An unreleased OpenAI model produced ~722 math papers and solved ~90 of Proof Atlas's top 500 open problems. Terence Tao declared the end of Math 1.0 and is organizing a boycott.

- Agents are pricing out the cheapest human labor: Philippines call-center headcount fell 5.5% in a year, and India declined for the first time since 2016.

The takeaway: stop buying chatbots and start specifying stacks, a decision model, a harness it cannot edit, and a kill switch. Capability is getting cheap. Control is the moat.

#AI #DecisionModels #OpenAI #AISafety #FutureOfWork

房迷 From Me Daily 10/12/2026

- 最近在家裡做了不少便利殘障的改動，算是第一次體驗到殘障人士的生活
- 因為我兒子只剩單腳，浴室最危險，淋浴下面增加座椅，馬桶加裝扶手
- 昨晚訂的電動輪椅到了，他第一次體驗開車的感覺，技術需要很多練習
- 如果要輪椅可走，地上有很多東西都得移除，像是腳踏墊之類
- 好在房子夠大，很多走道空間，就是在這時候才有價值
- 平常看房子，會說這邊那邊浪費空間，也算是不懂殘障生活的表現
- 輪椅進浴室非常麻煩，光是轉進去跟出來，就超級難
- 迴轉半徑不會開車的人還蠻難理解的，經常會撞到各種邊角
- 最後讓他換用一間比較小的廁所，輪椅留在外面，裡面搭配板凳
- 跟弟弟可以一人一間，也是方便很多，這時候家裡廁所多還是有好處的
- 好在換到一層樓的房子，舊家超多樓梯，會超惡夢
- 當時我想的是，一層樓可以住到死，等我老了坐輪椅也能住
- 沒想到現在是我兒子幫我先試用了
- 殘障人士在美國很幸福，超市百貨都有輪椅可用，地方大也很輪椅友善
- 希望早點拿到殘障車牌，就會再更方便一點

- 太多人要退休，也是灣區房地產的一個風險
- 過去十年，賺到錢足夠在別處退休的人實在太多，可能慢慢開始發酵
- 尤其是台灣人幾乎都是腳底抹油，跑得很快，因為回台灣退休太爽
- 中國人不喜歡共產黨的，還有點動力留，但很多無所謂的，也會回國
- 美國房市有一點讓房價很難跌，賣家同時也是買家
- 你總是要住，買過房的人較難接受租房，所以一買一賣，沒有增加市場供給
- 要讓房價跌，需要大量有壓力的賣家，比如金融海嘯就是，非得賣，賣完不會買
- 而回到原本國家退休的人，正是這種賣完房不會買的人
- 當然，蠻多人走了，會把房子留下而不賣，也有是兩邊住一半一半更爽
- 但如果是把房子換成錢，去別處退休的人，會願意虧點錢賣
- 這種人有多少，沒人知道，所以還是無法預測未來，也建議不要預測

- 這次期中選舉，加州三個法案跟房市有關係
- Prop 1: 州政府舉債$11.25B蓋可負擔住宅，民調通過率55%
- 資金投入特定住宅計畫，包含蓋高密度、affordable housing、退伍軍人房貸等
- 反對的人主要擔心政府借款成本、財政資源分配，跟可能不實際改善可負擔性

- Prop 37: 州政府提供最高17%房價的第二順位房貸，民調通過率61%
- 允許CalHFA發行最多$25B的債，只適用買新房，二手房不可
- 讓買家可以3%頭期款，加上17%政府貸款，然後80%正常貸款買房
- 同時兩筆房貸，還是需要通過收入、債務負擔以及貸款機構的審核
- 解決頭期款問題，不保證總月付金額一定比其他融資方式低
- 參與的建商必須符合較高的勞工訓練及用工標準，但放鬆瑕疵責任
- 我覺得對需求刺激強大，多數人卡頭期款，限定買新房會鼓勵蓋房
- 對二手townhouse跟condo會是再次打擊

- Prop 45: 大幅修改CEQA，縮短房屋開發審批時間，民調通過率49%
- CEQA是1970年通過的環境審查法，建案要對超多環境因素評估
- 這次要讓符合定義的計畫選擇新的審查程序
- 支持者認為幫助許可取得，減少蓋房成本
- 反對者認為減少民眾參與，也減少政府及法院阻止不合法建案的能力

Altos Research數據(week 10/09)
- Santa Clara County
- Market Action Index維持在49(Strong Seller's Market)
- 房屋要價中位數回到之前的$1.85M
- 新上市房屋價錢中位數上升到$1.999M (上週$1.974M)
- Price per sqft在$1011，上週$1013
- 房屋在市場上中位數上升到35天，跟上週一樣
- 降價比例上升到29.2%，上週26.09%
- 房屋庫存量1161間，上週1173間
- 這週數據上變化超少，基本上價錢跟賣的速度都沒改變
- 就是買方變少後，賣方也不太動了
- 市場上就是一堆TH，我會認為這些TH賣方，價錢硬的都賣不掉
- 買方選擇很多，真心想買的人能挑的房子多
- TH/condo應該是十年歷史上最多貨可以選的時候

- San Mateo County
- Market Action Index上升到54(Strong Seller's Market)
- 房屋要價中位數下降回$2.188M (上週$2.298M)
- 新上市房屋的要價中位數下降到$1.799M (上週$1.993M)
- Price per sqft $1119，上週$1143
- 房屋在市場上中位數21天，上週28天
- 降價比例19.46%，上週21.18%
- 房屋庫存量從458下降到447間
- 半島的房子又變少了，這邊仍然維持很少房子可以選的狀態
- 最近有看到明顯房租在上升，這個不管南灣跟半島都是
- 大家不買房的時候，房租就會上升，因為都去搶租房
- 然後房租到一個地步，又會推動想買房的心，這是很正常的發展

10月1日、国内最大の発電会社JERA、米デル・テクノロジーズ、英レルムの3社が、千葉火力発電所の隣に最大40万kWのAIデータセンターを建てる覚書（正式な契約の前に方向性を確認する合意）を結びました。
投資額は150億ドル以上で、2028年ごろから段階的に動かし、2029年に本格運転する予定です。

背景にあるのは「電気の順番待ち」です。
千葉県の印西・白井エリアでは供給できる量を超える申し込みが集中し、変電所づくりには通常10〜15年かかるとも言われます。
水道で例えるなら、蛇口は増えるのに水道管の工事が追いつかない状態。
だからこそ「浄水場の隣に住んでしまう」発想が生まれました。

しかし、懸念もあります。
電気はLNG（液化天然ガス）火力由来なのでCO2が出ますし、湾岸の1カ所に集中するため災害時のリスクもあります。

実際、米国ではAmazonが原発隣のデータセンターで直結の電気を増やそうとしたところ、FERC（米連邦エネルギー規制委員会）が「一般の電気代や安定供給に影響しかねない」として2024年に却下しました。

スピードを取るか、公平さと脱炭素を取るか。
私は国がどんな接続ルールを用意するかに注目しています。
あなたはこの「近道」、賛成ですか？

跨云架构管理：维护及优化 AWS（EKS/EC2）与阿里云（ACK/ECS）资源，规划 VPC/VPN 专线串接与高可用性架构
LLM 私有化部署：运用 vLLM、Ollama 或 TGI 部署开源大模型（如 Llama、DeepSeek、Qwen），搭建 LLM API 网关（LiteLLM/Nginx）进行授权、限流（Rate Limit）与 Token 计费

2. DevOps & QA：CI/CD 与自动化测试整合（TestOps）
自动化测试框架：使用 Python（Pytest/Playwright/requests）建立 API、集成与 E2E 自动化测试，维护 Test Fixtures 与 Mock Services
CI/CD & IaC 流程自动化：使用 Terraform/Ansible 实现基础设施即代码；将自动化测试与模型部署深度整合至 GitHub Actions / GitLab CI，搭建 PR 测试拦截与定期回归机制
3. QA：AI 模型、数据质量与性能验证
AI/LLM 质量评估：建立 Golden Dataset 与模型质量门槛，运用抽样评估、LLM-as-a-Judge 或语义相似度验证推理输出的正确性、一致性与稳定性

4. QA & DevOps：可观测性与质量流程管理（Observability & Quality）
系统与 GPU 可观测性：通过 Prometheus、Grafana、DCGM 与 ELK 监控 GPU 状态、显存占用率、API 延迟与 Error Rate，建立实时排障与告警机制

AIの進化が速すぎて、エンジニアリング戦略が計画サイクルより先に前提から崩れてしまう、という内容。

・戦略計画から半年後、コードの量は増えたが、デリバリーは速くならなかった
・PRのレビューに時間がかかり、CIのキューが伸び、セキュリティ検証も詰まっている
・これは計画がAI導入前のソフトウェアデリバリーのモデルを前提にしていたため

・CloudBeesの調査では、企業のコードの61%にAIが関与している
・ただ、ボトルネックはレビュー・テスト・デプロイだと答えた企業が57%で、コード作成の35%を上回る
・LeadDevの調査では、AIの影響を適切に測れている組織は31%のみ

・Gartnerは、2027年末までにagentic AIプロジェクトの40%超が中止になると予測している

・コード生成能力だけを上げても、検証能力が伴わなければボトルネックが移動するだけで終わる。

・ではどうするか？

・重要な意思決定ごとに「何を決めるか」「何が成り立っている必要があるか」「どの兆候から見出すか？」「どの閾値で見直すか」「いつ見直すか」を明確にしておく

・また、前提と観測シグナル、担当者、見直しトリガーを書いた一覧台帳を作って運用する
・例えば「AIによるコーディングで供給力が上がる」という前提なら、リードタイムやレビュー時間を見て、レビュー能力の伸びが実装より遅ければ再評価する

・他にプラットフォームチームやセキュリティ、スタッフエンジニアなど現場のシグナルを見ている人を、意思決定者につなぐ

・必要なのは自信満々の5年計画ではなく、前提を確認して軌道修正する仕組み
・ロードマップは四半期ごとに変えなくてよいが、その根拠となる証拠は更新される余白があった方が良い

records.text:
别再让 AI 乱写代码了，这套技能把工程纪律装回它脑子里

如果你已经在用 Claude Code、Codex 或 Copilot 写真实项目，大概率遇到过这四种翻车：它没搞懂你要什么就开写、啰嗦得像在凑字数、代码跑不起来、改到最后变成一团泥。Matt Pocock 把自己 .agents 目录里的日常技能整理成了一个开源仓库，思路不是「让 AI 全权接管流程」，而是把工程基本功拆成一个个小而可组合的技能，随时能改、能换模型。

先说适用场景。适合你已经在用编码 agent 做正经项目，但发现它经常跑偏、或者你想给团队定一套可复用的协作方式。如果你只想让 AI 快速糊个玩具，这套东西的仪式感可能偏重。

具体怎么用。安装有两种路子：插件方式会自我更新；https://t.co/YPJ0Cfi5aa 方式是把可编辑文件拷进项目、由你手动更新。两者选一个就好，同时装会让每个技能出现两遍。装完在 agent 里跑一次 /setup-matt-pocock-skills，它会问你三件事：用哪个 issue tracker、triage 时打什么标签、生成的文档放哪。每个仓库跑一次即可。

最值得先试的两个。一是 /grill-me 或 /grill-with-docs，动手前让 agent 反过来追问你，把设计树上的分支都问清楚；后者还会顺手沉淀项目术语表和 ADR。二是 /tdd，强制红-绿-重构循环，先写失败测试再修。调试硬骨头可以用 /diagnosing-bugs，先建一个能稳定复现的反馈回路，再最小化、假设、埋点、修、补回归测试。

容易踩的坑。第一，别指望 /improve-codebase-architecture 帮你把祖传泥山一次性理干净——它是巡检，能找出值得加深的模块候选，但不会替你拆。第二，技能分「用户调用」和「模型调用」两类：前者只能你手敲（比如 /grill-me），负责编排；后者 agent 在合适时能自己触发，承载可复用的纪律。用户调用技能可以调模型调用技能，但不会去调另一个用户调用技能，理解这条边界才不会用乱。第三，别一上来全套上，挑当前最痛的那个失败模式先试。

怎么验证有没有用。看三件事：agent 是不是在动手前问的问题变多了；同一个概念在变量、函数、文件名里是不是叫法统一了；你改一个功能时，测试是不是先红后绿，而不是先写实现再补测试。这三条比任何宣传都诚实。

AI News Digest — October 13, 2026

Meta Muse Wonder / Muse Wonder Full (released October 12, 2026)
Meta Superintelligence Labs launched its first frontier-class models, optimized for long-running personal and professional agent tasks with Active Memory and Active Focus, a reported 1M-token context, and multimodal inputs. Muse Wonder is available via the Meta Model API (approximately $4 input / $20 output per million tokens) and Muse Code; the stronger Full variant is limited to higher Muse Code tiers. Independent Artificial Analysis scores place Wonder around 52 and Full near 56.
This matters because it marks Meta’s return to the closed frontier model race with agent-focused capabilities, competing directly with leading systems from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google on sustained multi-step work.
https://t.co/miSG3MMMRE

Anthropic Frontier Red Team: small models and IoT self-replication (published October 12, 2026)
Anthropic’s red team reported that models under roughly 30B parameters can already complete many steps of autonomous replication on cheap consumer hardware (e.g., off-brand Android TV boxes) and that, at historical improvement rates, full end-to-end capability on such devices could arrive by year-end 2026. Tests included sharded inference on low-cost hardware and simplified propagation on emulated networks; real-world exploit steps were kept trivial, so results represent an upper bound.
This matters because it highlights a potential pathway for decentralized, hard-to-shut-down AI replication that does not require data-center compute, raising practical security and containment questions for open-weight models.
https://t.co/3Q1RQjVfaw

QwenGyre elastic RL framework for extreme-long-horizon agents (detailed/announced October 12, 2026; arXiv September 27)
Alibaba’s Qwen team described QwenGyre, an online RL system that elastically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training and processes branching trajectories to reduce redundancy. On the flagship Qwen 3.8 2.4T model it delivered a ~6-point gain on NL2RepoBench and end-to-end training speedups of up to ~1.8× versus Async/Colocate baselines for multi-hour, near-1M-token rollouts.
This matters because long-horizon agent training is currently limited by GPU idle time and trajectory explosion; efficient frameworks like this accelerate progress on sustained coding, refactoring, and multi-step agent workloads.
https://t.co/q83lmbnATe

Infinigence AI Series C (~$344 million / RMB 2.3 billion, closed around October 12, 2026)
The Chinese AI-native infrastructure company (Tsinghua-linked) closed a record China AI-infra Series C with participation from Tencent, Baidu, Lenovo, and others. Cumulative funding exceeds RMB 4.3 billion; the firm supports mixed-chip training/inference across many accelerator types and has filed confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO.
This matters because it underscores heavy capital deployment into heterogeneous, efficient token-production infrastructure in China, parallel to large Western AI-infra valuations and relevant to compute access and export-control dynamics.
https://t.co/OggpT65892

ByteDance Seed creates dedicated Model-Alignment & Preparedness department (announced October 13, 2026)
ByteDance’s frontier lab established a standalone unit (led by Yan Lin, reporting directly to Seed head Wu Yonghui) focused on model specifications, safety evaluations, alignment training, agent authorization limits, and CBRN risk monitoring. It absorbs members from the prior Responsible AI team and parts of the Chat team.
This matters because it institutionalizes safety and alignment at the same organizational level as model development inside a major Chinese lab—the first such dedicated structure reported for a domestic frontier team—amid growing emphasis on agent controllability.
https://t.co/pzRM71WN20

These items dominate the last 24 hours. Smaller releases (e.g., OpenBMB MiniCPM-V 4.7 MoE multimodal, NVIDIA Run:ai open-sourcing) and routine product updates were excluded. No major new U.S. or EU legislative enactments appeared in the window; the ByteDance reorganization is the clearest organizational/policy signal.

昨晚 https://t.co/wsjynRjkJZ 有个帖子问：企业里的敏感 PDF/Word，怎么脱敏再喂给 AI 整理？十几条回复几乎一边倒——本地部署。

这个话题单独看没什么新鲜的，但把评论区的实战经验和开源工具链拼成一条完整 pipeline，还是值得收藏的。先说最重要的：

**先定级，再谈路线。**

真涉密（有保密等级、走保密规定的）：别喂 AI，没有路线好谈，老老实实按规定来。这是评论区里唯一正确的回答。

企业敏感、但没到涉密级别：三条可操作路线。

**路线一：本地小模型做脱敏预处理，再喂大模型（评论区共识）**

27B 这个量级（Qwen3-27B 这类）做文档整理和 PII 识别完全够用。流程：本地模型先过一遍，把人名、金额、公司名、身份证号标出来替换掉，脱敏后的版本再喂给主力大模型做整理。

关键细节：脱敏后人工抽查一遍。自动化检测不保证找全，这是铁律。

**路线二：占位符替换法**

敏感实体换成 {姓名1}、{金额A}、{公司X}，AI 整理完再按映射表替换回来。

适合字段明确、结构化的文档。散文式长文本、实体在上下文里反复变形的，映射成本会很高。

**路线三：关键词机械替换（AA/BB 化）**

写个脚本把特定名词统一替换成代号，快。代价：上下文语义被破坏，AI 只能做纯语言层面的整理；有心人结合公开信息，有可能反推回去。

**开源工具链**

- Microsoft Presidio：PII 识别 + 匿名化的开源项目（现由社区 Data Privacy Stack 维护）。四个模块：analyzer（文本识别）、anonymizer（脱敏）、image-redactor（OCR 扫描件打码）、structured（结构化数据）。官方文档自己写了：自动化检测不保证找全，必须配合人工抽查。中文 recognizer 需要自己加规则。
- 元数据清理：很多人忘了作者名、修订记录、批注也在文档里。exiftool / mat2 清一遍再外发。
- "神人 PDF"：扫描件注意 OCR 隐藏文本层和批注，肉眼看不见不代表 AI 看不见。

**三个容易被忽略的坑**

1. 中转 API 喂敏感文档 = 把数据多喂几家。评论区原话：官方 key 数据喂官方，中转 key 多喂几家中转。省钱的代价是数据多跳几手，自己掂量。
2. 别在脱敏上自我感动：关键词替换后，结合上下文和公开信息可能被反推。真要强保证，只有纯本地。
3. 权衡框架：数据分级 × 模型部署位置（公有 API / 私有化部署 / 纯本地）。别一刀切，也别把"本地部署"当万能答案——27B 本地跑的成本和运维，本身就是一笔账。

- 帖子：https://t.co/aisKQEBgCB
- Presidio：https://t.co/WLkh9eGYj0

LightOn released ColGrep-Agent-2B (Oct 12), an open Apache-2.0 model that does code search locally for your coding agent. It searches the repo with ColGrep, reads files, follows references, and hands back file paths, line ranges and the code.

- Built on MiniCPM5-2B: a short SFT cold start (Qwen3.5-27B as teacher), then 500 steps of GRPO
- Default Q8_0 GGUF is ~2.5 GB. Uses Metal on Apple Silicon, Vulkan on NVIDIA/AMD/Intel, CPU fallback. No Python, no inference server, no API key
- Hooks for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode

LightOn's test: Claude Code on Sonnet 5.5, 52 code-search questions, 13 repos created in 2026, 624 sessions. Code search only, not end-to-end coding tasks.
- API tokens per question: 142k with grep → 93k (−34.3%, 95% CI 28–40%)
- Cache-aware cost per question: 7.3¢ → 4.4¢ (−40%)
- Correct answers: 83.3% → 80.8%, not statistically significant (CI −10.9 to +5.1 pts)
- Time per question: 13.0s → 21.6s
- Savings grew with repo size: 19% under 50k lines, 40% at 150k–600k
- Balanced mode: −21% tokens at the same 83.3% accuracy

On SWE-bench Lite code localization it scores 19.92 line F1, the highest in LightOn's table, ahead of Gemma 4 31B (17.08) and Qwen3.5-27B (15.71).

https://t.co/7V5l4bU1s6

这是截至目前我发现的 TapeOut 最牛逼、也最有潜力的项目，没有之一

先说明：这是我的个人研究判断，不是项目方公告，更不是喊单。

这个项目叫 **21 NAND / AI Hashrate**@

很多人看到它，会以为只是“用 21 个 NAND 门做了一辆会转向的小车”。如果只看到这里，就低估它了。

它真正展示的是一条过去几乎没人跑通的路线：

**把一个已经学会任务的 AI，从黑盒模型拆成确定性的逻辑门，再把这套逻辑写成 TapeOut Circuit，让任何人都能读取、验证、复算，甚至继续走向真实芯片。**

项目公开仓库里的小车控制器，原始逻辑网络被降成 21 个 NAND 门，并写入 BNB Chain 上的 TapeOut 电路 #279。选择链上求值后，小车每一次转向，都可以由节点按照链上网表计算，而不是相信项目方服务器返回一个结果。

这件事为什么可能是 TapeOut 的关键转折？

因为它第一次让我看到，TapeOut 不只是“挖 BEM”“铸造电路”或“把网页永久保存”。它可能成为一种全新的计算资产层：

1. **算法可以变成电路资产**：不只保存代码哈希，而是保存可执行、可验证的逻辑本身。
2. **AI 可以脱离单一平台长期存在**：只要公开网表和执行规则还在，任何人都能复现其计算，不必依赖某家 API 或服务器。
3. **数字逻辑与真实芯片之间出现通道**：同一套逻辑可以先在浏览器运行、再进入链上 Circuit，最终继续走向版图和物理制造。
4. **TapeOut 的晶体管、电路和容器第一次有了非常具体的 AI 需求场景**：不是为了挖矿而造电路，而是为了让可验证计算真正运行。

更值得关注的是，这并非只有一张概念图。公开仓库已经给出电路、处理器地址、Circuit ID 和交易哈希；同一项目族还在探索 Agents API 门电路、三值点积、模型转网表、Pi 工作台，以及 Bard 小型 Transformer 到 SKY130 版图的路线。

如果这条路线继续跑通，它打击的不是某一个 AI 应用，而是“模型只能锁在公司服务器里、用户只能相信输出”的旧范式。

未来一个小型模型、Agent 工作流，甚至某种设备控制逻辑，都可能成为一份可验证、可继承、可组合、可再次制造的链上计算 IP。

这才是我认为它目前最有潜力的原因：

**它不是给 TapeOut 再增加一个应用，而是在回答 TapeOut 最重要的问题——这些链上晶体管和电路，除了挖矿，到底能承载什么真正有长期价值的东西？**

当然，边界必须讲清楚：

- 21 NAND 小车和部分小型参考电路已有公开代码及链上样本；
- Bard 完整约 50.7 万 NAND、9 万 LATCH 的网表目前尚未完整部署到 TapeOut；
- 已生成版图不等于真实芯片已经制造，更不等于已经完成商业验证；
- 相关代币不自动代表代码、Circuit、知识产权或未来芯片权益。

所以它现在仍是一个早期、高风险的技术实验。但在我目前跟踪的 TapeOut 项目里，**21 NAND / AI Hashrate 是少数真正把“链上电路”从金融叙事推向可验证计算和开放芯片叙事的项目。**

如果 TapeOut 未来真的能走出自己的独立价值，我认为这条路线很可能是答案之一。

项目入口：https://t.co/J88fMhKXDq

开源代码：https://t.co/yQpDlzMdB9

开发者：@zhuoning293

你认为未来最值钱的链上资产，会是代币、数据，还是一套能够被任何机器重新执行和制造的计算逻辑？

records.text:
Just got off an impromptu call with @JamesTervit, @NotJustShaking Lee and a new friend from Belgium, Drees.  We went DEEP on local AI...

James has been pumping out long AI videos and every frame is LOCAL.  Lee has tried making the same kind of thing in the cloud.  His words: do 30 seconds of video and you've drained your tokens in 20 minutes.

That's the whole problem in one line.  In the cloud you're not limited by your creativity, you're limited by your token meter!

And the hardware door is closing fast.  The RTX PRO 6000 that went for about $8K at launch is now listed at $16,000 on Nvidia's own store, out of stock, and James says he's seeing them go for way more than that.  Most people are getting priced out of real local AI completely.

So James brought his telecom brain to it.  When his team scaled a mobile network from 250K users to 25M, they did NOT build 100x the gear.  Only about 10% of users ever push the system to the max at the same time, so you build for that 10% and everybody gets served.

Now apply that to AI.  Pool real compute as a community instead of everyone hoping for the best with a 3060 or a 5090 under the desk.  Coding and chat run real time for ~1,000 people at once.  Video and images go in a queue, maybe a 30 second wait.  Line up 20 jobs, walk away, come back to 3 minute videos instead of 15 second clips.  No token anxiety.  James has something brewing here, stay tuned on that one!

My confession: I fell so hard into the frontier models that I barely touched local.  So I asked James if my 12GB GPU is basically worthless.  His answer: NOT even close.  Put a fast SSD behind it for offloading and caching and a 12GB card can start running 27B to 35B models.

He's going to help me tune mine up, and I'll share everything we learn.  If you've got a 12GB card sitting there doing nothing but games, it might be time to put it to work.

/Nix and Larry

开源 AI 编程工具 OpenCode 2.0 正式亮相，此前已在 7 月开启公测。这次升级的一大变化是 Code Mode，可以把 MCP 服务和 OpenAPI 接口转成 JavaScript 函数，让 Agent 在一段脚本中串联多个工具。比如先从 GitHub 批量读取 Bug，再逐条创建 Linear 任务，不用每处理一条数据就让模型重新发起调用。所有 MCP 服务默认启用 Code Mode，也能减少工具定义占用的上下文。

OpenCode 还重写了底层架构。终端、网页和桌面客户端现在共享同一个本地后台服务，可以访问同一批会话。子 Agent 和 Shell 命令也能在后台运行，例如让一个 Agent 审查代码，主 Agent 继续修改文件，同时执行测试和构建。团队还将大量内部功能做成插件，目前已超过 80 个，支持运行时热加载，Agent 可以为自己编写插件并立即使用。

此外，OpenCode 推出了可嵌入其他应用的 SDK。Cloudflare 已宣布通过实验性接口支持 OpenCode 2.0，让开发者能在 Durable Objects 中运行同一套 Agent 引擎，并保存会话、恢复中断的任务。

不过，这次重构也带来了兼容性问题。1.x 插件需要改写，旧版 Server API 也需要适配。GitHub 上有 issue 指出，Code Mode 调用耗时较长的插件时缺少超时限制，可能让会话长时间处于等待状态，只能手动中断。

$TER $FORM

Once optical alignment takes under a second, the 100-plus seconds it takes to test one photonic chip sets the pace of the whole line, and the cost comes down to how many stations can share each expensive instrument.

The two US companies that cover both halves of that test just teamed up. On October 6, Teradyne agreed to buy 2,234,887 new FormFactor shares for about $300 million in a private placement, roughly $134 a share and about 2.8% of FormFactor after the issue. FormFactor filed the 8-K today. The joint release lists silicon photonics next to HBM and advanced packaging, and Teradyne CEO Greg Smith said it plainly: "The most demanding test challenges in advanced packaging, silicon photonics, and memory can't be solved by a single company."

The split of work lines up with the bottleneck. FormFactor brings the probe, the interface and optical access at the wafer. Its Triton CPO test system took Systems revenue from $27.9 million in Q1 to $48.5 million in Q2, and management expects CPO revenue to pass $20 million by the end of Q3. Teradyne brings the tester. It bought Quantifi Photonics for $127.2 million in May 2025, and it sizes CPO test alone at $300 million to $700 million by 2028, with 2027 starting around $200 million at the low end.

FormFactor's Q3 report is the next checkpoint: how far past $20 million CPO revenue lands, and whether Triton orders start showing up alongside Teradyne testers. As test time becomes the line rate, I'm bullish on $TER and $FORM through the 2027-2028 CPO ramp.

微軟推出「決策模型」：對瘋狂建數據中心的震撼反思

​微軟近日無預警推出專為路由與分類打造的「決策模型」Microsoft-Decision-1（底座曾採用阿里 Qwen），每百萬 token 僅需 0.042 美元且輸出免費。

這項新技術的崛起，正戳中了當前 AI 產業最敏感的痛點——當輕量、高效的決策模型能以極低成本搞定企業流程時，過去那種盲目砸大錢堆砌雲端數據中心的邏輯，正在面臨嚴峻的經濟學考驗。

​「算力軍備競賽」面臨ROI拷問：
過去幾年，科技巨頭深陷「大模型就是一切」的迷思，砸重金無止境地擴建數據中心與採購天價 GPU。然而，決策模型的出現證明了：絕大多數企業級的 AI Agent 工作流，根本不需要動用耗電驚人、成本高昂的通用大模型來硬解。當「花小錢辦大事」成為可能，盲目堆疊算力的性價比（ROI）正受到市場的強烈質疑。

​從「大而全」轉向「垂直與精細」：
微軟此舉與企業端注重安全的私有化邏輯不謀而合。市場要的不是無所不能卻容易幻覺的通用大模型，而是安全、高效、成本可控的系統協同。

決策模型的興起意味著 AI 的下半場不再是純粹拼數據中心規模的「暴力美學」，而是轉向拼落地效率與成本控制的精細化生存。

Onchain inference market is heating up.

Tokens processed per day via onchain inference projects are up 5x in 3 months.

The next big narrative is the financialization of compute & inference. Put simply, this means GPU compute, Inference capacity, and AI commodities will become tradable assets onchain.

The onchain inference market can be broadly classified into 3 primary buckets:

> Marketplace Model (Projects like @AskSurplus @AntSeed)

They use an orderbook/P2P style framework to route cheap inference via providers. Requests are settled onchain via stablecoins. Users get ~80-98% savings compared to official APIs.

> Bittensor subnets (Chutes SN64, Engy SN53, Actual SN95, gm SN28 and more)

Specialized verified inference networks running on consumer GPUs offering cryptographic proofs/TEE encryption and verified model outputs.

> Financialization layer

The idea behind these platforms is to turn inference capacity into a commodity that can be hedged, long/short, or used like yield.

@Architect_Fi is building cash-settled futures using GPU-hour prices. You don't get the actual GPU; you speculate on the price or hedge your current exposure.

Here's a list of crypto AI inference projects worth keeping an eye on:

> @actualinc (SN95): Heterogeneous Bittensor inference network that routes models across mixed consumer hardware (Macs, PCs, home GPUs).
> @AntSeed: P2P open marketplace for AI inference.
> @BlockRunAI: Agent-native pay-per-request LLM router using x402.
> @chutes_ai (SN64): Serverless decentralized AI inference/compute on Bittensor with TEE end-to-end encryption support.
> @darkbloomai: Private decentralized inference network that routes encrypted requests to idle Apple Silicon Macs.
> @dphnAI (Dolphin): Distributed inference network + unrestricted models
> @engyai (SN53): Verified inference for frontier open models on consumer GPUs with cryptographic proofs.
@MorpheusAIs: Decentralized open marketplace for AI inference with TEE-backed providers and an OpenAI-compatible API.
> @orbiodotso: Discounted AI credits platform + agent launchpad where agents earn inference via staking.
> @AskSurplus: Open orderbook marketplace for AI inference.
> @AskVenice: Private/uncensored multi-model AI platform.

Global inference demand is rising, and crypto is becoming the settlement, pricing, and financing layer behind this growth.
